nodes.title: The agent builder's voice stack picker lists every stack from shared/stacks.ts with nothing preselected and nothing marked recommended; choosing is local until Save draft; Publish is disabled with a reason while no stack is chosen; tests of an agent with no stack come back 'invalid, with the reason', never a pass.
nodes.rationale: Owner directive decision.2026-10-21.stack-choice-no-default plus state integrity (no click-to-save). Each figure shows its grade and source; a missing price shows 'not measured', never 0.
nodes.reverse_if: The owner picks a default stack after round-2 ratings.

nodes.title: A disabled primary action must carry a reason: the Btn component's TypeScript type requires `reason` when `disabled` is true. A test fails the build if a dropdown change calls a write tool, if a colour literal appears outside tokens.css, or if any text colour pair is under 5:1 in light or dark.
nodes.rationale: Must-be D (state integrity) and the 5:1 text contrast law from the design language, made mechanical so they cannot drift.
nodes.reverse_if: A real flow needs a silent disabled control; none was found.

nodes.title: Web bundle: first load 81.4 KB gzip (main JS + CSS), all page chunks 137.5 KB gzip, 431.6 KB raw, built by esbuild with React 19 and lucide-react.
nodes.rationale: Budget in the design language is 170 KB gzip JS per route; the test pins 100 KB first load and 200 KB total.

nodes.title: The workspace tool registry JSON is not in the repo, so web invented tool ids and result shapes (web/src/types.ts, STATUS.json needs_from_others). Real modules must return those shapes or web adapts once told. Also: a person pressing Pause gets an approval request because A3 verbs run at once only for agent/system actors.
nodes.rationale: Screens were verified only against stand-in tools and the real Operator module with a scripted fake model.
